title: MIDI file signature (MThd)
summary: A Standard MIDI File (SMF) begins with the 4-byte chunk id 'MThd' followed by a 4-byte big-endian chunk size (always 6 for the header chunk).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Bytes 4-7: header chunk length, big-endian, always 0x00000006.
Bytes 10-11: number of tracks. Bytes 12-13: division (ticks per quarter note or SMPTE).
